summary.intent: Investigate two nightly CI runs whose web soak legs failed but passed on retry, find root causes, and fix/triage them.
summary.outcome: Traced the 10-28 Web Shares failure to a POST /auth/login that never reached Cloudflare (runner/network stall), and the 10-27 failure to a real DNS-dependent ipfs.example pin call. Opened draft PR #2538 adding an `api-timeout` retry class and an ipfs.example route stub, ran simplify and security review (clean), trimmed comments and pushed; triage comments on #2536/#2532 were approved but not shown as posted.

repo: Staging API (Nest) logs no HTTP requests and Caddy has no access log for api-staging; the only latency evidence is the Prometheus http_request_duration_seconds histogram, sar, and Cloudflare analytics.
Soak runs keep no Playwright trace (#2434), so network-level stalls can't be localized from CI artifacts.
The engine's control-call deadline is control_ms = 10_000 via AbortSignal.timeout in packages/client/src/seams/http.ts; placement_ms is 60 s.
loginRetry classifies transient refusals via the DEVNET_FAULTS regex table; a new fault class is a type union entry, a regex entry, and a unit-test row.
Running `pnpm i` modifies tracked Husky hook files and they must be restored before committing.
Cloudflare Free plan GraphQL lacks client ASN and edge TTFB, and the analytics query endpoint is rate limited.

code.finding: Added 'api-timeout' to the DevnetFault union and a DEVNET_FAULTS regex matching 'api transport error: seam error: signal timed out' so timed-out API sign-in calls retry and are counted.
The dual-pin save issues a real POST to https://ipfs.example/pins; the test now aborts that host via context route with namenotresolved so runner DNS speed can't cause the 5 s timeout flake.

workflow: Verify subagent claims with a spot-check before reporting.
MCP servers added mid-session aren't available until a new session; local-scope registration is per worktree path, so user scope is better.
When asked whether logs were checked, actually check them; cross-referencing metrics counts (137 challenges vs 136 logins) with Cloudflare edge records pinpointed the stall location.
Reducing comment lines in small PRs on request: keep comments that explain non-obvious reasons, drop ones that restate code.

friction: Initial shell quoting error when downloading logs/artifacts.
Cloudflare MCP rate-limited the first queries, requiring a 5-minute wait.
The Cloudflare MCP wasn't usable in the session until restart, and was registered with local scope.
Assistant initially hadn't checked staging server logs and was prompted by the user.
No Caddy/API request logs on staging limited the server-side evidence.
open_items: Post triage comments on #2536 and #2532 and close them, linking PR #2538 (approved; completion not shown).
Verify the ipfs.example route stub also catches requests from the worker (needs a run of the spec on the full local stack).
Playwright trace retention for soak runs (#2434) remains unimplemented and would localize the next network stall.
If the API timeout recurs, check /auth/challenge and /auth/login latency on staging at that time.
The 10-26 incident #2503 was already closed; no new issue was filed for these failures.
